pageData.heading: How to Use Your Property’s Value to Get extra funds
pageData.para: Knowing where to start can be the biggest hurdle. The right tools and support will get you moving. You must be familiar with financial products like Top-Up Loans and Loans Against Property (LAP). These products allow you to unlock the value in your property and use it to borrow funds for various needs. In simple terms, the value of your property can be used to secure a loan, giving you access to funds without having to sell or move out of your home.

equity.heading: Understanding Home Equity
subPara: Home equity refers to the portion of your property that you own outright. It’s the difference between your home’s current market value and what you still owe on your mortgage.
paraGraph: If your property is worth ₹50 lakh and you still owe ₹30 lakh on your home loan, your home equity is ₹20 lakh.
This ₹20 lakh is the portion you can use to get a Top-Up Loan or a Loan Against Property (LAP) .

contents.heading: Top-Up Loan
contents.para: A Top-Up Loan allows you to borrow more money on top of your existing home loan. The loan amount is generally determined by the value of your property and the outstanding balance on your home loan.

cards.heading: How Does it works
cards.para:
Banks typically offer up to 80% of the property’s market value, minus the current outstanding balance on your home loan.

For Example:
  • Your property’s market value is ₹50 lakh.
  • You have an outstanding home loan of ₹30 lakh.
  • You can borrow up to ₹10 lakh (which is 80% of ₹50 lakh = ₹40 lakh – ₹30 lakh outstanding loan).
This means, the more your property is worth, and the lesser you owe on your current loan, the higher your Top-Up Loan eligibility can be.

cards.heading: Advantages of a Top-Up
cards.para:
• Low Interest Rates: Top-Up loans typically have lower interest rates compared to personal loans.
  • Quick Approval Process: The process is quicker than applying for a fresh loan.
  • Flexible Usage: You can use the loan amount for any purpose like home improvement, funding education, or paying for a wedding.

cards.heading: How to Apply for a Top-Up
cards.para:
• Check Your Property’s Market Value: Get a valuation to know the maximum loan amount you may be eligible for.
  • Eligibility Check: Ensure you meet the eligibility requirements for a Top-Up Loan, which will typically include a good credit score and an income check.
  • Submit Documents: Provide necessary documents like income proof, property papers, and the details of your existing home loan.
  • Loan Disbursement: Once approved, the loan amount is disbursed, and you can use it for your intended purpose.

contents.heading: Loan Against Property (LAP)
contents.para: A Loan Against Property (LAP) is another popular option for leveraging the value of your property to secure a loan. Unlike a Top-Up Loan, which is based on your existing home loan, LAP allows you to pledge your residential, commercial, or industrial property for funding.

cards.heading: How LAP Works
cards.para:
• Loan Amount: The amount you can borrow typically ranges from 60-70% of the property’s market value.
  • Interest Rates: LAP interest rates tend to be higher than Top-Up Loans but lower than personal loans.
  • Loan Tenure: LAPs often come with longer repayment tenures, usually up to 15-20 years.

cards.heading: When to Consider LAP
cards.para:
• For large expenses like funding a business, paying for medical emergencies, or buying a second property.
  • You may also consider LAP if you have other property or a higher-value asset that you wish to use as collateral.

cards.heading: How to Apply for LAP
cards.para:
• Get Property Valuation: You will need to get your property valued to understand how much loan you can avail.
  • Eligibility Check: Banks will evaluate your repayment capacity based on your income, credit history, and the value of the property.
  • Submit Documents: Provide necessary documents such as property papers, income proof, and bank statements.
  • Loan Disbursement: After approval, funds are disbursed, and you can use them for your chosen purpose.

howUseEquity.heading: How Can You Leverage Your Property’s Value for Big Goals?

cardData.title: Buying Another Home
cardData.para: If you plan to buy a second home or an investment property, a Top-Up Loan or LAP can provide you with the funds required for the down payment or full purchase.

cardData.title: Renovating Your Existing Property
cardData.para: A Top-Up Loan or LAP can also help you renovate or upgrade your current property, increasing its value in the long run.

cardData.title: Starting a Business
cardData.para: If you’re planning to start a business, both Top-Up Loans and LAP offer a way to secure funds based on your home’s equity, without having to sell or liquidate other assets.

Check Eligibility: Speak with your bank or lender to confirm eligibility criteria for a Top-Up Loan or LAP.
Submit Required Documents: Provide property-related documents, income proof, and details of your current loan (if applicable).
Loan Approval and Disbursement: Once approved, you will receive the loan amount, which you can use for your planned purpose.
